name: nyx-dlp
description: Modern Electron GUI for yt-dlp, gallery-dl, M3U8 downloads and YouTube live archiving

scripts.build:portable: electron-packager . "nyx-dlp" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist/portable --overwrite --extra-resource=scripts --icon=assets/icon.ico --ignore="(/node_modules|/dist|\.md$|/__pycache__|/scripts)" && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/portable/nyx-dlp-win32-x64/.portable','')" && node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'),v=require('./package.json').version;execSync('powershell -Command Compress-Archive -Force dist/portable/nyx-dlp-win32-x64 dist/nyx-dlp-v'+v+'-portable.zip');"
